stages.title: Enjoy the story — missable watch
stages.note: Play the opening hours for fun, but keep a separate save before airport (VCIA) and showroom story sequences: the two trophies in this stage can be missed if their one-time moments pass, so grab them the moment the opportunity appears.

stages.title: Story completion
stages.note: Run the main story from Gone Fishing through the final mission, earning every chapter and named-mission trophy in order. Nothing here needs side content, so just follow the story markers to the credits.

stages.title: Stranger strands & side missions
stages.note: Work through the stranger mission strands across Leonida, running each chain to its final mission — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone individually, eight strands in total for the silver, plus Bret's unique-animal hunt.

stages.title: Collectibles & exploration sweep
stages.note: Sweep Leonida methodically: meditation spots, collectible card sets, WAiNK It locations, vehicle discoveries and full map exploration. No trophy on the official list requires multiplayer, so this and every other stage can be done solo.

stages.title: Activities & challenges
stages.note: Sample every activity type once, then grind the mastery layer: 250 stunts, gold medals in all Shooting Range challenges, drone race wins at every location, 20 race wins, fishing, arcade, bowling and 50 challenges.

stages.title: Free-roam feats, robberies & fortune
stages.note: Clean up the open-world feats: partner wanted-level and shop-robbery chains, Combat Focus, stealth and vault robberies, gang operations, the money trophies for laundering and spending, all garages, vehicle registrations and the vague hidden-style trophies whose exact triggers only become clear after release.

stages.title: Cleanup & platinum
stages.note: Use the in-game completion checklist to close out 100% completion, then the platinum pops automatically once all 54 other trophies are earned.
